title: Looking for a B2B Lead Generation / Sales Partner for n8n & AI Automation – Reve
text: Hi everyone, I’m an independent n8n / AI automation builder based in Lithuania and I’m looking for a long-term lead generation / sales partner. I’m NOT looking for someone to build automations. I handle the technical side myself. What I need from a partner is: – identify businesses that may need automation – reach out to them by email / LinkedIn – have the initial conversation – confirm they have a real automation problem or need – gather basic context about what they want automated – introduce the qualified prospect to me by email/message From that point I handle everything else: technical discovery, pricing, implementation, revisions and delivery. I prefer client communication to continue primarily through email/chat rather than calls. I’m open to a performance-based model, for example 15–20% of collected project revenue for clients you source and qualify. Commission is paid after the client pays. Typical services include n8n workflows, AI integrations, APIs, CRM / Google Workspace automation, lead handling, email automation and other business process automation. I’m looking for someone who wants a genuine long-term partnership, not someone selling scraped lead lists. If interested, DM me with your experience, the markets you normally target and how you would approach getting the first qualified prospect.
triage_reason: Automation developer looking for a sales/lead generation partner.
